[!dolt] skip
# Test bd update validation failures
bd init --prefix test --quiet

! bd update nonexistent-id --title 'New title'
stderr 'not found|no issue found|Error fetching'

bd create 'Test issue' --description 'Update validation target' --json
extractid ISSUE

! bd update $ISSUE --priority 99
stderr 'priority'

! bd update $ISSUE --estimate -5
stderr 'estimate'

! bd update $ISSUE --due not-a-date
stderr 'invalid --due format'

! bd update $ISSUE --set-metadata bad
stderr 'key=value'
